name: find_string_end_and_call
description: Walks a pointer forward until it reaches the zero terminator of a string, then calls another routine with that end position and the second argument. It is string-handling code in the Diskfont.library shared library.

name: skip_string_to_terminator
description: Steps forward one byte at a time from the current pointer until it reaches a zero byte, then passes the terminator position to another routine. It is string-handling code in the Diskfont.library shared library.

name: count_string_length
description: Counts the bytes before the zero terminator of the string it is given and returns that count. It is string-handling code in the Diskfont.library shared library.

name: count_bytes_to_terminator
description: Increments a counter for every byte read from a pointer, including the zero terminator, and returns the total. The counter starts from the value already held in its data register.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns zero when they are identical through the terminator. At the first mismatch it returns minus one or one depending on which byte is lower.

name: compare_strings_with_early_exit
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings whose pointers are held in address registers, and returns zero as soon as the first string ends. Otherwise it returns minus one or one depending on the byte order at the first mismatch.

name: compare_strings_by_byte_order
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings using pointers held in address registers, stepping both together. It returns zero when they match through the terminator and minus one or one at the first mismatch.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for a given byte and returns a pointer to its first occurrence. It returns zero if the terminator is reached before a match.

name: scan_register_string_for_byte
description: Walks forward through a zero-terminated string from a pointer held in an address register, returning the position where the byte matches a value held in a data register. It returns zero if the terminator comes first.

name: scan_string_after_first_byte
description: Steps past the current byte of a string before testing, then walks forward until a byte equals a value held in a data register, returning that position. It returns zero if the terminator comes first.

name: find_last_character_in_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and then scans backward from its final byte for a given character. It returns a pointer to the last match, or zero if the character does not occur.

name: find_byte_scanning_backward
description: Walks backward from a pointer held in an address register, returning the first position whose byte equals a value in a data register. It returns zero when the position falls below a lower bound held in another data register.

name: find_byte_backward_bounded
description: Steps an address register backward one byte before each test, returning the position where the byte matches a data-register value. It returns zero when the stepped position goes below the lower bound held in another data register.

name: skip_past_path_separator
description: Searches a name string for a slash and, if none is found, for a colon. It returns the position just past whichever separator it finds first, or the original position when neither is present.

name: increment_register_value
description: Returns the value passed in a data register with one added to it. It is a small arithmetic routine in the Diskfont.library shared library.

name: call_handler_and_return
description: Calls another routine and then returns without changing anything else. It is a pass-through entry in Diskfont.library that is reached through a pointer stored in data.

name: call_external_handler
description: Calls another routine and returns, so it only forwards the call to an external handler. It is reached through a pointer stored in data in Diskfont.library.

name: forward_to_library_vector
description: Loads a library base pointer from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed offset from it, returning that function's result. It is a library stub that only forwards the call.

name: call_routine_pass_through
description: Does nothing but call another routine and return, leaving the registers as the callee set them. It appears in Diskfont.library as a wrapper reached through a data pointer.

name: initialize_display_and_startup
description: Program entry code that clears a block of memory and builds a copper display list with bitplane pointers. It sets the audio, DMA and interrupt registers, waits on raster-position loops, and then returns.

name: acknowledge_interrupt_or_halt
description: Checks a global status flag and, when a bit is set, enters an endless wait loop, writing a byte to a fixed address first when the flag equals one value. Otherwise it writes a single value to the interrupt request register to acknowledge a pending interrupt.

name: draw_text_string_glyphs
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string and copies each character's glyph rows from a font table into a bitmap buffer, starting a new line for control codes below the space character. When the string ends it stores a value derived from the final byte and clears a companion word.

name: fill_buffer_descriptor_fields
description: Writes the address of a global buffer and three fixed numeric values into a structure pointed to by an address register. It only stores the fields and returns.

name: run_blitter_frame_update
description: Waits for the blitter to become free, adjusts a group of memory words and calls a per-step routine several times. It then starts a 20-word-wide blitter copy, updates the display pointers and sets the DMA control word.

name: run_blitter_update_step
description: Performs the blitter-wait, memory word adjustment, per-step calls and 20-word-wide blitter copy in the same way as its neighbour, without first setting the DMA control word. It then updates the display pointers.

name: update_blitter_copy_frame
description: Waits for the blitter, adjusts a group of memory words and calls a per-step routine several times, then starts a 20-word-wide blitter copy and sets the display pointers. It is the same sequence without the earlier counter check.

name: xor_circle_pixels_bitmap
description: Plots a circular pattern by XOR-ing pixels in a one-bit bitmap, computing each step from a squared-distance check and a lookup table. Each point is mirrored about the centre and written to one of two buffers depending on a flag.

name: plot_circle_pixels_from_table
description: Continues the same circular XOR plotting, reading each vertical offset from a precomputed table and writing mirrored pixel pairs into one of two bitmap buffers chosen by a flag.

name: plot_circle_pixels_xor
description: Plots mirrored XOR pixel pairs of a circular shape into a one-bit bitmap, testing each step's squared distance against a limit and reading the offset from a lookup table. The flag selects which of two buffers receives the pixels.

name: open_use_and_close_library
description: Opens a system library by name, calls two of its functions, closes it again and returns the value five. It is the entry code of the IFF file library and identifies itself through its built-in version text.

name: setup_iff_list_structure
description: Stores a supplied pointer in a structure, obtains a value from a library call and initializes an empty linked list header inside the structure. It is the setup step for an IFF data record.

name: allocate_and_queue_iff_entry
description: Allocates a memory block, records the calling task in it and links it onto a list, then increments a count held in the structure. It runs only when a condition flag is set.

name: release_iff_entry_if_unused
description: When a condition flag is clear, removes a node from its list and frees its memory block. It then decrements a count and, when the count reaches zero with a flag bit set, calls a follow-up routine.

name: free_entry_or_mark_pending
description: If a count held in the structure is zero, it removes the node, closes its library, frees the memory and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a pending flag bit in the structure and returns zero.

name: close_free_and_remove_entry
description: Removes a node from its list, closes a library, frees its memory block and returns a value stored in the structure. It is the unconditional teardown sequence for an IFF entry.

name: open_and_verify_iff_form
description: Opens a file through a DOS call and reads its first four bytes to check for the IFF FORM identifier. It allocates a record for a valid file and returns an error code otherwise.

name: open_iff_file_verify_form
description: Opens a file through a DOS call, reads the first four bytes and checks for the IFF FORM identifier, returning an error code when the open, allocation or check fails. The body matches its neighbour at the preceding address.

name: read_iff_form_chunk_header
description: Reads the first bytes of an IFF chunk from an open file and checks for the FORM identifier. It allocates a record for the chunk size and stores the position and length in it, or returns an error code.

name: allocate_iff_chunk_record
description: Allocates a memory block sized to hold a header plus the chunk data, fills in its size and type fields and reads the chunk data from the open file. It returns an error code if the read fails.

name: read_chunk_into_record
description: Stores a value in the first field of a record, reads file data into the following field and stores two parameters after that. It closes the file afterwards and returns the record, or an error code when the read fails.

name: store_fields_and_close_file
description: Stores three values into a record at the address held in an address register, then closes the open file through a DOS call. It returns through a follow-up routine, and several callers use it as the finishing step.

name: forward_call_unchanged
description: Calls another routine and returns without adding any work. It is a pass-through entry in the iff.library code.

name: free_block_if_present
description: Frees the memory block passed in an address register when that pointer is non-zero, then calls another routine and returns. It is the release step for an optional allocation.

name: search_chunk_list_by_id
description: Walks a list of length-prefixed records inside a buffer, stepping over each record's size, and returns the record whose identifier matches the value in a data register. It returns zero when no record matches before the end of the buffer.

name: return_result_plus_eight
description: Calls another routine and returns its result increased by eight. The addition is always applied because its condition flag is fixed to false.

name: decode_three_byte_groups
description: Reads a packed sequence of three-byte groups from a chunk located by an earlier lookup and writes one 16-bit value per group into the destination. It returns the number of values written.

name: decode_ilbm_bitplane_rows
description: Checks for the ILBM form type, reads the bitmap header fields and processes the image rows plane by plane, accumulating values per row. It calls other routines to copy the decoded data and then a cleanup routine.

name: copy_bytes_counted
description: Copies bytes from a source address to a destination address, with the count held in a data register and the copy running one byte past that count. It is a plain memory copy loop.

name: unpack_packbits_run_stream
description: Decompresses a PackBits-style run-length stream, where a non-negative control byte copies that many following bytes literally and a negative one repeats the next byte. It stops when the count held in a data register is used up.

name: pass_call_to_next_routine
description: Calls another routine and returns without any other work. It is a wrapper reached through a data pointer in the iff.library code.

name: write_iff_ilbm_file
description: Opens a file and writes an IFF ILBM image, starting with the FORM and bitmap header chunks, then the converted pixel data and a BODY chunk. It closes the file on completion and closes it again on each error branch.

name: finish_iff_chunk_write
description: Pads a written chunk to a four-byte boundary when needed, then seeks and writes the padding and closes the file once the writes succeed. It is the closing step of the IFF file writer.

name: close_file_if_open
description: Closes the DOS file whose handle is held in a data register when that handle is valid, then returns. It is a conditional cleanup routine.

name: write_rows_accumulating_totals
description: Computes eight accumulated values from the header words, then writes data rows to a file one at a time while adding those values to each row. It returns the write error when a write fails and a computed total otherwise.

name: write_encoded_rows_totals
description: Writes rows to a file through a DOS call, encoding each row with a separate routine and summing the encoded lengths. It returns the total length, or the write error when a write fails.

name: encode_byterun1_row
description: Compresses a row into PackBits-style records, emitting a literal block or a repeat record followed by the data byte, and returns the number of bytes produced. Runs of three or more identical bytes become a single repeat record.

name: encode_byterun1_remainder
description: Continues the same PackBits-style run encoding for the remaining bytes of a row, emitting literal or repeat records and returning the number of bytes produced.

name: encode_byterun1_literal_blocks
description: Encodes the remaining bytes of a row as PackBits-style literal blocks and repeat records, returning the number of bytes produced. It is a variant of the run encoder entered at its literal step.

name: measure_repeat_run_length
description: Tests how many following bytes match the first byte, stopping at a mismatch, the end of the data or the run limit of 128. It is the repeat-detection step of the run encoder.

name: find_list_entry_for_task
description: Finds the current task's record in a list held in the structure by comparing each node's task field with the task identifier. It returns the matching node, or zero when no entry matches.

name: clear_result_field_if_unset
description: Clears a 32-bit field of the structure when a condition flag is not set, then always returns one. It is a small status update in the IFF reader.

name: store_nonzero_result_field
description: Stores the value in a data register into a structure field when that value is non-zero, then returns zero.

name: take_result_field_value
description: Returns the value stored in a structure field and clears the field, or returns minus one when the preceding check fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one without doing any other work. It is a stub that always reports failure with that value.

name: read_chunk_info_flags
description: Returns a 32-bit value read from a fixed offset of a record returned by an earlier call. The branch that would OR in an extra flag bit is never taken, so the value is returned as read.

name: return_value_with_flag_bit
description: Calls another routine to get a value and, when a condition flag is clear and a byte in the structure exceeds five, sets an extra flag bit in that value before returning it.

name: build_threshold_flag_word
description: Builds a flag word from two 16-bit values and a byte in a structure, setting one bit when the first value exceeds a threshold while a byte condition holds, and another bit when the second value exceeds its limit.

name: run_ilbm_row_accumulation
description: Continues the ILBM image decoding for a set of rows without repeating the form-type check, accumulating values per row and calling other routines to copy the decoded data. It is the row loop of the same decoder.

name: decode_ilbm_rows_from_header
description: Runs the ILBM row decoding using header fields already read into the structure, calling other routines for each row and accumulating values. It ends by calling a cleanup routine.

name: run_ilbm_plane_rows_step
description: Runs the ILBM row accumulation for one plane, calling other routines that copy decoded data, and jumps to a cleanup routine when a condition flag is set.

name: finish_ilbm_plane_rows
description: Runs the ILBM row accumulation for one plane using the row count from a data register, calls other routines to copy data, then runs a cleanup routine.

name: run_ilbm_plane_when_flagged
description: Runs the ILBM plane row loop only when a data-register flag equals one, calling other routines for each row. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns.

name: run_ilbm_plane_rows_loop
description: Runs the ILBM plane row loop unconditionally, calling other routines for each row and accumulating values, then calls a cleanup routine.

name: store_argument_in_font_handle
description: Requests a handle from a library call and, when one is returned, writes the argument into a field at a fixed offset of the handle and calls a second library routine. It returns true when a handle was obtained, otherwise false.

name: store_argument_in_font_handle
description: Requests a handle from a library call and, when one is returned, writes the argument into a field at a fixed offset of the handle and calls a second library routine. It returns true when a handle was obtained, otherwise false.

name: open_two_libraries_init_list
description: Opens two system libraries and, when both succeed, initializes an empty list header inside the structure and returns its address. If either open fails, it closes what was opened, frees the structure and returns zero.

name: remove_unused_entries_and_close
description: Walks a list and unlinks each entry whose counter is not positive, calling a release routine for each one. When no entries remain and a flag is clear, it closes the libraries, frees the structure and returns its stored value; otherwise it sets a pending bit and returns zero.

name: close_and_free_when_idle
description: Closes two libraries, frees the structure and unlinks it from its list when no flag is set and the counter is not positive. Otherwise it sets a pending bit and returns zero.

name: mark_structure_pending_close
description: Sets the pending bit in a structure's flag byte and returns zero. It defers the close until the counter allows it.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's pointer table.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the pending bit in a structure's flag byte and increments a 16-bit counter stored in the same structure.

name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in the structure and, if it is still non-zero and the pending bit is set, calls a library routine through a table entry. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: compute_font_match_offset
description: Computes a signed score by comparing two 16-bit size values and then walking the bits of two flag bytes, subtracting a lookup-table entry for each bit that differs. It returns a fixed sentinel value when the second size is zero.

name: scan_fonts_directory_best_match
description: Scans the FONTS: directory through DOS calls and selects the font entry with the highest computed score, updating counters and flags in the matching list entries. It uses temporary memory and a file lock, and releases both before it returns.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination up to and including the zero terminator. It is plain string copying in diskfont.library.

name: locate_path_separator_pointer
description: Looks for a slash in a name string and, if there is none, a colon, and returns a pointer to the separator found. It returns the original pointer when neither separator is present.

name: enumerate_font_entries_into_buffer
description: Fills a buffer with font entry records, first from the library's internal font list and then from the FONTS: directory when the flags request it. It returns the space remaining, as a negative value when the buffer ran out.

name: append_font_list_entries
description: Appends one font record for each entry of the internal font list into a buffer, then scans the FONTS: directory for further entries when a flag bit is set. It returns the space remaining, negated when the buffer ran out.

name: copy_name_entries_into_buffer
description: Copies the names of the internal font list into a buffer as records, and when a flag bit is set also scans the FONTS: directory. It returns the remaining space, negated when the buffer ran out.

name: scan_fonts_directory_entries
description: Scans the FONTS: directory through DOS calls and writes a record for each font file it accepts into a buffer, returning the space remaining. Accepted names carry the font suffix, which the code checks by searching for a separator.

name: record_font_directory_entries
description: Continues the FONTS: directory scan, writing a record for each matching font file found and returning the space remaining in the buffer.

name: read_font_directory_entries
description: Reads the FONTS: directory listing through a DOS read call, writing a record for each font file it accepts, and returns the remaining buffer space.

name: write_font_records_from_listing
description: Writes font records for matching entries of the FONTS: directory listing, returning the space remaining in the buffer. It is the record-writing continuation of the directory scan.

name: release_directory_lock_and_report
description: Restores the previous current directory and releases the directory lock through DOS calls, then returns the space remaining, negated when the buffer ran out.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero without doing any other work or accessing memory.

name: call_handler_and_return

name: call_external_handler

name: wait_for_task_message
description: Looks up the current task and, if its message port is empty, waits for a message and fetches it. When a message arrives it forbids multitasking and replies to it, then returns zero.

name: wait_for_frames_count
description: Waits for display frames by calling the frame-wait routine in a loop, running for the count held in a data register plus one.

name: start_megaball_main_program
description: Startup routine that checks for the required fonts, libraries and devices named in its text, opens the audio and timer devices, loads the IFF images and music, and shows a prompt for the player count and the quit key before entering its main loop.

name: enter_handler_stub
description: A six-instruction entry stub with no library calls of its own, reached through a handler pointer and an address reference. It acts as an entry point rather than doing the work itself.

name: reply_pending_port_message
description: Replies to a message from an exec port and makes four calls to other routines around that reply. It is reached through a handler pointer and is called from two places.

name: service_messages_and_blit
description: Retrieves messages from ports, copies memory blocks, blits bitmaps, moves sprites and clears a raster area, calling thirteen other routines. It replies to messages through the exec library.

name: call_program_handler_stub
description: A six-instruction stub that makes one call to another routine. It has no library calls of its own and is reached through a handler pointer.

name: pass_call_to_next_routine
description: Calls another routine and returns without any other work. It is a wrapper reached through a pointer stored in data.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work. It is a single-instruction entry in the program's pointer table.

name: shut_down_devices_and_ports
description: Aborts and waits for pending device requests, closes devices, removes interrupt servers and ports, frees signals and memory, and replies to messages. It is the cleanup routine of the program.

name: draw_label_and_move_sprites
description: Draws a short text label with the graphics library, moves sprites and clears raster areas, using a drawing mode set beforehand. It calls eleven other routines.

name: setup_screen_and_palette
description: Sets up an Intuition screen, loads a colour palette and sets the pointer, and drains pending port messages by replying to each. It calls five other routines.

name: drain_messages_and_move_sprite
description: Waits for the frame, replies to port messages until none remain and moves a sprite. It calls three other routines.

name: compute_position_and_step_values
description: Updates position and step values held in global words, comparing them against limits and calling three other routines to fetch values. It has no library calls of its own.

name: blit_and_move_sprite_step
description: Replies to a port message, blits a bitmap and moves a sprite, calling three other routines. It is called from three places.

name: adjust_coordinate_within_bounds
description: Adds three to a coordinate held in a data register when a flag is set, and returns the original value when the other coordinate lies outside the range from eight to 154. It is a small position check.

name: lookup_cell_from_coordinates
description: Checks a coordinate against the bounds from eight to 154, converts two coordinates into cell indices by division, reads a byte from a computed table offset and calls four other routines.

name: start_decimal_text_conversion
description: Sets the divisor for a decimal conversion and passes control to the digit loop that writes the number as text characters.

name: convert_number_to_decimal_text
description: Converts a number into decimal characters by repeated division by a divisor and writes each digit as an ASCII character into a text buffer.

name: blit_sprite_rows_loop
description: Loops over a row counter, blitting a bitmap block at fixed positions and calling one other routine. It is called from three places.

name: draw_score_and_board_labels
description: Builds the text labels for a score and a board display in memory, then moves the drawing position and draws them with the graphics library. It calls four other routines.

name: blit_grid_cell_if_valid
description: Checks a value by subtracting sixteen, dividing by seven and testing that the division is exact and below twenty-one, and blits a cell when the test passes.

name: blit_after_frame_wait
description: Blits a bitmap through the graphics library in a wrapper that waits for the frame first. It calls eight other routines and is called from four places.

name: move_sprite_table_entries
description: Walks a table of sprite entries, clamping each position to the 320-wide display area and moving the sprite with the graphics library.

name: fade_palette_entries_step
description: Scales the 4-bit red, green and blue components of a palette table by a step value divided by fifteen, adds a fixed offset and stores the results in a second table. It calls one other routine.

name: fade_palette_entries_partial
description: Performs the same palette scaling as its neighbour with a fixed step of twelve out of fifteen, storing the adjusted colour values in the second table.

name: scale_palette_entries_by_step
description: Scales each 4-bit colour component of a palette table by the step value divided by fifteen and stores the results in a second table, without adding an offset.

name: load_palette_at_full_level
description: Scales palette entries to full level and loads them into the display with the graphics library's palette call, waiting for the frame first.

name: abort_pending_io_requests
description: Repeatedly calls a routine through the library table, which aborts pending device requests, until it reports zero.

name: wait_for_pending_io
description: Repeatedly calls a routine through the library table, which waits for a device request to finish, until it reports zero.

name: prompt_and_load_board_file
description: Prompts for a board file name and opens and reads it through DOS calls, reporting 'File not found' and asking for a full path when the open fails. It draws its prompt text with the graphics library.

name: open_dos_library
description: Opens dos.library through the exec library and stores the returned base pointer in a global variable.

name: open_intuition_library
description: Opens intuition.library through the exec library and stores the returned base pointer in a global variable.

name: close_library_base
description: Closes a library through the exec library call, using a stored base pointer, and returns.
